items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren @ CLE: 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches; Dowdle out again. CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game.
LOVE Drake London @ NO: 35% target share/104 ypg career w/ Penix; 43.5% last week (9-194). NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
HATE Omarion Hampton @ SEA: low utilization (RB27), 3.5% targets, 25% routes, 42% snaps W3, only 13% 3rd down. SEA 2.9 YPC allowed.
